value.name: Daniel pleads through the door
value.description: Daniel speaks from outside the sewing room in a calmer, more reasonable tone, asking them to open the door and insisting the situation may be a misunderstanding.
evidence: Daniel's voice came again, lower now, pitched for a hallway rather than a stairwell — something about not wanting any of this to turn on a misunderstanding, about the papers maybe not saying what they thought they said, would they please just open the door.

value.name: Lucia fears Daniel's reasonable tone
value.description: Lucia reacts with fear to Daniel's changed, reasonable register, recognizing it as the kind of behavior she most distrusts.
evidence: Lucia's hand tightened on the edge of the drawer at the changed register of him, the reasonable one, which was the one she had clearly learned to be most afraid of

value.name: Asha signals they will leave together
value.description: Asha silently tells Lucia they will go down together and take the journal with them.
evidence: Asha met her eyes and tipped her head once toward the door to say they would go down together and that the journal was going with them.

value.name: Rosa warns Asha by text
value.description: Asha receives a message from Rosa warning that Daniel is fishing and urging her to bring the journal and Lucia downstairs immediately.
evidence: Asha's phone buzzed once against the wood of the chair, and she glanced down to read Rosa's message: he's fishing, don't let him talk you into a misunderstanding, bring the journal and Lucia down now.

value.name: Asha secures the journal and key
value.description: Asha pockets her phone and the silver key, then places the journal and loose page into the blue folder and grips it tightly.
evidence: She closed her hand around the phone and then slid it into her pocket along with the silver key, lifted the journal and its loose half-sheet into the blue folder so the leather pressed the page flat against the cardstock, and tucked the folder under her arm with her fingers curled hard around the handle.

value.name: Lucia joins Asha at the door
value.description: Lucia moves close to Asha and silently confirms the plan with a small, uneven breath and a nod.
evidence: Lucia was already at her shoulder, close enough that Asha could hear the small uneven breath she took before she nodded.

value.name: Asha opens the sewing room door
value.description: Asha turns the knob and opens the sewing room door into the hallway, bringing Lucia and the folder with her.
evidence: Asha turned the knob and opened the sewing room door onto the narrow hallway

value.name: Daniel confronts them in the hallway
value.description: Daniel stands back from the threshold with his hands raised in a practiced reasonable posture, and his expression shifts when he sees Lucia and the folder.
